product.title: Philadelphia's Italian Market Food Tour

description.text: Walk South Philadelphia's Italian Market on a guided food tour with tastings at the vendors and eateries that define this historic neighborhood. Your guide shares immigrant stories while you sample cheeses, cured meats, and baked goods along South 9th Street. The two-hour format delivers enough bites for a satisfying lunch while exploring one of America's oldest outdoor markets. A popular choice for food lovers who want authentic South Philly flavor without a private booking.

highlights: Guided Italian Market food walking tour
South Philadelphia neighborhood and vendor tastings
South 9th Street market stalls and specialty shops
Immigrant food history and local commentary

end.description: Tour ends near the final vendor stop on South 9th Street.
